items.title: Meta reportedly built a humanoid robot prototype that can do household chores
items.excerpt: Meta has reportedly built a household-chore humanoid robot prototype codenamed Max, running on Nvidia Jetson Thor, and is already working on Max 2, per The Information.

items.title: Samsung’s first AI glasses could arrive in December, but only in two countries
items.excerpt: Citing ChosunBiz, Samsung is planning to launch its first AI-powered smart glasses in mid-December, initially only in South Korea and the US.

items.title: Logitech releases MX Master 4 Developer Edition with AI support and new design
items.excerpt: Logitech listed an MX Master 4 Developer Edition mouse in China; a Logi Options+ plugin maps its shortcuts and Actions Ring to the WorkBuddy AI assistant.

items.title: HomePod Mini 2 first look: Three things I love and one disappointment
items.excerpt: The Verge's first look at HomePod Mini 2: faster, quieter Siri on a new chip, though the headline Siri AI upgrade isn't available yet and arrives in a later update.

items.title: The Wild World of Third-Party AI Apps for Ring Security, and Whether You Need Them
items.excerpt: CNET examines the growing store of third-party AI apps for Ring cameras, which let HOAs, landlords and others analyze footage in new ways, and whether ordinary owners need them.

items.title: No internet, no problem: Google is working on an offline mode for Gemini Live
items.excerpt: An Android Authority APK teardown shows Google working on an offline mode for Gemini Live, which would run voice conversations on-device without an internet connection.

items.title: Apple CEO says the company doesn’t ‘want to ship AI for AI’s sake’
items.excerpt: On Apple's earnings call, new CEO John Ternus defended Apple's AI pace, saying the company doesn't 'want to ship AI for AI's sake' across its devices.

items.title: Google and NASA build AI medical robot for Mars missions
items.excerpt: Google and NASA built a voice-guided AI medical assistant robot for deep-space missions; early tests show an 85% task success rate.

items.title: Smart Glasses Detector Apps Are Here. How Well Do They Work?
items.excerpt: Bluetooth-scanning apps like Zuckoff can tell you when camera-equipped AI smart glasses are nearby, but CNET finds they can't tell whether the glasses are recording.

items.title: Senators send stern letter to Meta over privacy risks from AI camera glasses
items.excerpt: Senators Ron Wyden and Ed Markey sent Mark Zuckerberg a letter accusing Meta's AI camera glasses of being 'tailor-made for invading' people's privacy.

items.title: Apple confirms iOS 27.3 beta is coming next week with Apple Intelligence in China
items.excerpt: Apple confirmed that the iOS 27.3 developer beta arrives next week and brings Apple Intelligence to iPhones in China for the first time.

items.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
items.excerpt: Rather than buy Meta's Muse Charm, a Verge writer built a $50 DIY AI Tamagotchi from a Waveshare ESP32 board, vibe-coded with Claude.

items.title: This electric screwdriver uses a camera and AI to figure out what bit you need
items.excerpt: Arrowmax's Arrowspace S1 electric screwdriver uses a tip camera and an AI model to identify a screw head and recommend the right bit; it's launching on Kickstarter.

items.title: Apple @ Work: Next to a growing token bill, Macs might start looking like a bargain
items.excerpt: 9to5Mac argues that if open-weight models take hold in the enterprise, Apple Silicon Macs running AI locally could look cheap next to growing cloud token bills.

items.title: Google is giving Gemini's overlay a literal sparkle on your Android phone
items.excerpt: Google is rolling out the redesigned Gemini overlay, with a new sparkling animation based on its Neural Expressive design language, to all Android phones.

items.title: Alexa can now manage your Amazon billing complaints, subscription changes, and more
items.excerpt: Amazon's Alexa for Shopping assistant now handles over 100 account tasks, including billing complaints, subscription changes and refund tracking.

items.title: Amazon's new Alexa Photo Frame could have what I've been missing - here's why
items.excerpt: ZDNET looks at Amazon's new Alexa Photo Frame, an Alexa+ smart display built around photos, announced alongside new Echo devices.

items.title: Samsung adds better sleep tracking to Galaxy Watches - here's what to expect
items.excerpt: Samsung is upgrading sleep apnea tracking on the Galaxy Watch Ultra 2, Watch 9 and Ring with a new AI algorithm that produces more detailed sleep reports, launching first in Korea.
